from sphinx.testing.util import SphinxTestApp
from pathlib import Path
import tempfile, textwrap, shutil

tmp = Path(tempfile.mkdtemp())
src = tmp/'src'
src.mkdir()
(src/'conf.py').write_text("extensions=['sphinx.ext.autodoc']\nmaster_doc='index'\n")
(src/'example.py').write_text(textwrap.dedent('''
__all__ = []

def foo():
    "docstring"

def bar():
    "docstring"

def baz():
    "docstring"
'''))
(src/'index.rst').write_text(textwrap.dedent('''
.. automodule:: example
   :members:
'''))

a = SphinxTestApp(srcdir=src, buildername='html', status=None, warning=None, freshenv=True)
a.build()
html = (a.outdir/'index.html').read_text(encoding='utf-8')
print('HTML length:', len(html))
print('Has foo?', 'foo' in html)
print('Has bar?', 'bar' in html)
print('Has baz?', 'baz' in html)
shutil.rmtree(tmp)
